description:
Make `CaptureSpec`'s growth methods validate only the entries they add, and apply a capture's base requests once, so growing a spec one request at a time is linear.

## Background

- `discover_paths`, `discover_tail`, `discover_kinds` and `discover_listings` (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/image.rs:586-652`) clone the whole spec, add the request and re-run `validate` (`:732-753`) over every held path, listing and pinned request. `discover_pinned` and `discover_pinned_kind` (`:660-685`) already validate only their request.
- Every check in `validate` is per entry (depth within `max_depth`, `ensure_semantic`, `validate_pinned_request`) or a count (`listings.len()` within `max_listings`), and every mutator goes through these methods, so every held entry is already valid. `RepositoryImage::close` validates the spec once (`:787`).
- `capture_proposed_base_inner` (`crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:334-486`) applies its base requests (configuration, registries, index, the issue listing and the event-log tail) before the first capture (`:479-483`) and again at the start of every discovery round (`:408-411`), returning early when that changed the spec. A capture grown from a start image (`grow_discovering`, `crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs:356-374`) receives them only through that round.
- Document-reference resolution captures each reference in its own bounded spec (`capture_document_reference_validation`, `validate.rs:940-964`, test `:3514`), so no capture grows by one reference at a time. The round-count tests over `counted_session` (`validate.rs:3618-3637`) are at `:3642,3655,3669`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `discover_paths`, `discover_tail`, `discover_kinds` and `discover_listings` validate only the entries a call adds plus the listing count, and clone nothing; a refused call leaves the spec unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-02: A capture applies its base requests once, to its initial spec or to its start image's spec, and no discovery round re-applies them.
- [hard] REQ-03: A proptest shows that, for generated specs and batches, a batch is accepted exactly when whole-spec validation of the grown spec succeeds, and that the grown spec is the same either way; a unit test shows that a refused batch leaves the spec equal to its prior value.
- [hard] REQ-04: The existing capture and round-count suites pass unchanged.

## Notes

- Behaviour is unchanged.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Capture specs validate only added entries
